name: Everflame Lantern
description: A dented tin lantern whose flame never dies, not in wind nor water.
mechanics: Bright light 20 ft, dim 20 ft more. Action, 1/long rest: the flame flares — each creature within 15 ft makes a DC 13 CON save or is Blinded until the end of its next turn.
notes: Balance: roughly Driftglobe + a once/day control burst. Revisit if it trivialises dark dungeons.

name: House rule: Grievous Wounds
description: Dropping to 0 HP leaves a lingering injury until a long rest + a Medicine check.
mechanics: Roll on the injury table (see notes). DC 15 WIS (Medicine) during a long rest removes it.
notes: Trying this for the Crimson Monastery arc only. Tell players before session 4.
